ordering: forward/reverse alternates by block and process; all cases in fixed order
pages: preallocated and touched; warmup 64 operations per mode; hot pages only
a_a_gate: 95% two-sided process CI within [0.97,1.03]; small-message absolute difference CI within +/-15ns
small_gate: one-sided95 upper of extra latency <=50ns for <=4KiB
comparison: 12 AA processes then 12 comparison processes; fixed budget. Comparisons for failed AA cases are diagnostic only; no retries or extra samples
borrowed_baseline: raw_borrowed writes the identical destination as BorrowedImageBuffer
image_baseline: raw_slot writes the identical destination as image; packed/dense use raw_a destination
candidate_change: BorrowedImageBuffer: exclusive owner, borrowed child views invalidated by reload/move/destruction; caller excludes concurrent access and stale borrows. The checked ImageView interface is retained. New window; no pooling with v1.
scope: same-process immutable provenance; proxy contract differs from native mutable verified API; preparation and query costs reported separately
